_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
Nyoka ya {num_players}-Wachezaji kwenye gridi ya {width}×{height}.
Unadhibiti nyoka {player_id}. Harakati zinazokubalika: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (au w/s/a/d).
Lengo: kuishi muda mrefu zaidi au kuwa mrefu zaidi na kupata alama ya juu zaidi (kikomo cha zamu {max_turns} zamu).

game_action.invalid_death: Njoka {player_id} yakwie nũndũ wa kũlea kwĩthukĩĩsya nesa.

outcome.all_dead: Nzoka syonthe ila syaĩ kw'o ĩvindanĩ yĩu nĩsyooaiwe.
outcome.turn_limit: Kikomo cha zamu kimefikia - alama bora inashinda kufungua kwa sare.
